notes.title: Pro Cycling Manager 2020 - Now Available!
notes.notes:
Hello Cyclists!

Today we're proud to announce that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1178400/Pro_Cycling_Manager_2020/]Pro Cycling Manager 2020[/url] is now available on Steam!

Watch the Launch Trailer for Pro Cycling Manager 2020:

https://youtu.be/V_25xaYzJ2I

New in the 2020 edition:

[list]
[*]The 21 official stages of the Tour de France 2020
[*][b]Career Mode[/b]:
[*]Manage the morale of your cyclists: they will make requests (inclusion in races, recruitment of cyclists, etc.), and your decision will affect their morale and performance. The transfer window is also crucial for maintaining balance within your team
[*]Motivation during races: in each race, the motivation of your cyclists is linked to morale and key events, such as wearing a jersey, winning in the previous stage, etc. A fully motivated cyclist can excel in pivotal moments in the race, including an accelerating peloton and preparation for the final sprint
[*]A new assistant to help you plan your races
[*]A redesigned dashboard
[*]Improved AI, more aggressive and adventurous
[/list]

Take on the peloton in over 230 races and 650 stages, from the Tour de France to La Vuelta to the classic events of the World Tour calendar.
Become the manager of a cycling team and take them to the top! To get there, you will need to manage finances and recruitment, plan your training and implement your strategy. And for the first time in the Pro Cycling Manager series, you must look after your riders and their morale! One decision can change everything...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35092181/bfc4dddc168b140df2aa52de7a43f5582b2d6b49.png[/img]

You must listen to the requests of your cyclists (inclusion in races, personal goals, etc.) and either agree to them or decline. You are the manager, only you can make the decisions that will maintain balance in your team and motivate your cyclists in crucial moments while trying to achieve the best results for your team.
You can also play as your own cyclist and pursue a career to the highest summits in the Pro Cyclist mode. Proved yourself in Career mode? Play online mode with up to 15 other players from all over the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35092181/e50d366d3d9d99a7d52c5d5f28dbe307a8f3e918.png[/img]


So don't hesitate anymore, jump in the peloton with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1178400/Pro_Cycling_Manager_2020/]Pro Cycling Manager 2020[/url]!

notes.title: Pro Cycling Manager 2020, available on June 4!
notes.notes:
Hello Cyclists!

Today we are proud to announce [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1178400/Pro_Cycling_Manager_2020/]Pro Cycling Manager 2020[/url] is coming to Steam on June 4, 2020!

Take on the peloton in over 230 races and 650 stages, from the Tour de France to La Vuelta to the classic events of the World Tour calendar.

Become the manager of a cycling team and take them to the top! To get there, you will need to manage finances and recruitment, plan your training and implement your strategy. And for the first time in the Pro Cycling Manager series, you must look after your riders and their morale! One decision can change everything...

You must listen to the requests of your cyclists (inclusion in races, personal goals, etc.) and either agree to them or decline. You are the manager, only you can make the decisions that will maintain balance in your team and motivate your cyclists in crucial moments while trying to achieve the best results for your team.



You can also play as your own cyclist and pursue a career to the highest summits in the Pro Cyclist mode. Proved yourself in Career mode? Play online mode with up to 15 other players from all over the world.

New in the 2020 edition:

• The 21 official stages of the Tour de France 2020
• Career mode:
o Manage the morale of your cyclists: they will make requests (inclusion in races, recruitment of cyclists, etc.), and your decision will affect their morale and performance. The transfer window is also crucial for maintaining balance within your team
o Motivation during races: in each race, the motivation of your cyclists is linked to morale and key events, such as wearing a jersey, winning in the previous stage, etc. A fully motivated cyclist can excel in pivotal moments in the race, including an accelerating peloton and preparation for the final sprint
o A new assistant to help you plan your races
o A redesigned dashboard
• Improved AI, more aggressive and adventurous

Be sure to add [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1178400/Pro_Cycling_Manager_2020/]Pro Cycling Manager 2020[/url] to your Steam whishlist to follow updates about the game.

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.0.5.1
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35092181/bfb175803010cb24b364dc5ca5433b5e26ca5185.png[/img]

Greetings riders!
We've released a new update for [b]Pro Cycling Manager 2019[/b]. Please read the Patch Notes below to learn about its content.

[h1]Interface[/h1]
[list]
[*] The calendar now displays a maximum of three races at the same time,
[*] Solved an issue where when a cyclist was alone, his position in the group was indicated as “back of the group”,
[*] Added a confirmation notification when you remove a user from your friends list,
[*] Fixed a issue where some Jerseys were missing a region,
[*] Replaced the “Quit” option with the option to return to menu during 3D races,
[*] Fixed an issue where during the middle of the race the pictograms GPM / SPRINT / START / END would pop-up.
[/list]

[h1]Multiplayer[/h1]
[list]
[*] Refusing a ranked matchmaking match does not cancel the current search,
[*] Added the ping icon to the multiplayer game page,
[*] Added an option, showing how many players are looking for a ranked race, as well as the minimum number required for a race to begin.
[/list]

[h1]Database[/h1]
[list]
[*] Updated statistics following the Tour de France.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Updated the Pro Cyclist creation tutorial (the age of the Pro Cyclist is set at 19 on PCM19),
[*] Fixed a bug regarding remaining distance display for users on the 1366 × 768 resolution,
[*] Fixed a bug that was making it impossible to use more than half more than 25 trading points as of August 1st,
[*] Fixed a bug on the transfers / teams page,
[*] Fixed a bug regarding the lighting of spectators,
[*] Fixed a bug related to light and shadow, where spectators in the lights would pass as if they’re in the shade 300m from the camera player,
[*] Fixed a bug where there would be no spectators in the 3D race for several stages in sprint 17,
[*] Pro Cyclist Creation: Fixed color bars that floating above the main and secondary axes,
[*] Results page: Added space between the icons in the results page for each ranking,
[*] Pro Cyclist Creation: Header title has been corrected so that it is not centered in relation to others.
[/list]

[h1]Races[/h1]
[list]
[*] Resolved the meter problem to indicate the winner of a round in Sprint mode.
[/list]

We've released a new update for [b]Pro Cycling Manager 2019[/b]. Please read the Patch Notes below to learn about its content.


[h1]Career Mode
[/h1]

• Solving an issue that gave back DA points to the player when hiring a cyclist.


[h1]Pro Cyclist Mode[/h1]

• Solving an issue that caused the team to have a negative interest in the player.
• The welcome message received was in “French” even with the game set to “English”.

• An incorrect message was shown when entering an empty name for a new team.
• “German-Speaking Switzerland” could only be seen on every jerseys after cycling through it.
• The language used in the language drop-down window used the last used language instead of the selected one.
•	The level of interest’s bar could become empty after reaching 100%.


[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

• Solving an issue where the player’s bottle of water could disappear.
• Solving an issue when the player was changing the language could crash the game.
• Solving an issue in the Hall of Fame when players are using a custom database could crash the game.
• In some uphill finishes (+2km), the A.I. could consume their red energy too early.
• Solving a case where a peloton could be riding too slowly in a mountain.


If you've experienced any issues please don't hesitate to share it on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/936140/discussions/1/]Technical Support Discussion[/url].

Sincerely,

notes.title: Hotfix: Pro Cyclist Mode
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35092181/f119ab9974ef866f3d3add8c7414f76a2872951c.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

We're pleased to tell you that the issue making players unable to play after the 2nd season on the Pro Cyclist has been resolved through a hotfix. However, recovery of the save files [b]is not guarantee[/b], this part of the issue will be fixed through a patch coming soon.

Until this is completely solved, we have a temporarily solution for you. Take a save file from [b]July 2019[/b], before the transfers opening.

[olist]
[*]Copy the .cdb file (according to the displayed date) from "[b]My Documents/Pro Cycling Manager 2019/Weekly saves[/b]".
[*]Paste the file in "[b]My Documents/Pro Cycling Manager 2019/Cloud/ [profil user]"[/b].
[i][b]Note[/b]: You can rename the file if you want.
[/i][*]Launch the game
[*]Load a save and find the added file.
[/olist]

In the event that this solution doesn't work, please do the same actions as mentioned above for but a save file from [b]December 2019[/b].

Once again, we deeply apologies for the inconvenience this issue caused to many of our players, please know that we are dedicated on making Pro Cycling Manager 2019 a better game.

Sincerely,

notes.title: Pro Cycling Manager 2019 is now available!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35092181/04164992b28a2281947943ec640e696e5dd69fd4.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone,

We're more than pleased to announce that Pro Cycling Manager 2019 is finally available on Steam!

To celebrate its launch, you can save [b]20%[/b] on the game until [b]July 4, 2019[/b].

Watch the Launch Trailer here: https://youtu.be/vLsoXQcn_PU

The game sets the standard for cycling race management on PC. Become the manager of a team of professional cyclists and guide them as they race in the Tour de France and any of the 200 races available in the game. This year's edition offers an even bigger experience:
[list]
[*] Lots of content with 200 races and 600 stages 
[*] Multiple modes: Career mode for managing teams, contracts and sponsors; Pro Cyclist mode for taking a cyclist up through the rankings to the ultimate prize
[*] New online multiplayer mode for up to 16 players
[*] New cyclist skill tree system 
[*] Improved AI for better immersion
[/list]
